## OpenCode

`identity.js` contains fallback `read` and `shell` tool descriptions and schema fields derived from OpenCode tool definitions. `test/identity.test.js` includes simplified source-shaped fixtures based on OpenCode identifier, session ID, User-Agent, request-header, `read`, and `shell` definitions. The bridge also fetches OpenCode source at runtime to derive request identity and tool metadata. No OpenCode branding assets are included.
